sections.title: Introduction: The Smoothie Analogy (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: Smoothies are complex signals composed of ingredients.
Decompose the signal into simple sine waves.
Time Domain shows waves over time.
Frequency Domain shows the wave components.
Transform data between these two domains.
animations: Create a blender labeled '#FFFFFF' at center.
Add strawberries and bananas labeled '#FF0000' and '#FFFF00'.
Animate blender mixing ingredients with smooth motion.
Fade out ingredients, show blended smoothie labeled '#FF69B4'.
Highlight '#FF69B4' smoothie as the final result.

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Language of Sine Waves (0:45-1:45)
lecture_lines: Sine waves defined by amplitude, frequency, phase.
View sine waves as rotating vectors, phasors.
Add waves together using the Superposition Principle.
animations: Transform sine wave into a rotating phasor vector.
Show multiple phasors adding to form complex waves.

sections.title: The Core Concept: The Rotating Windmill (1:45-3:15)
lecture_lines: Fourier Transform acts as a mathematical sieve.
Multiply signal by complex rotating exponentials.
Align rotation speed with signal frequency.
Shift center of gravity reveals components.
animations: Create a windmill arm rotating labeled '#FFA500'.
Plot rotating tip point on a circle path.
Project the vertical shadow of the arm.
Animate arm rotation and shadow movement.
Final static frame showing arm and shadow mapping.

sections.title: The Result: The Frequency Spectrum (3:15-4:15)
lecture_lines: Transition from wave-form to bar chart.
Peaks represent the DNA of signals.
Filter noise or compress data efficiently.
animations: Draw a blank bar graph labeled '#FFFFFF'.
Populate bars showing different frequency components.
Change bar color to '#7FFF00' to highlight peaks.

sections.title: Conclusion & Real-World Application (4:15-5:00)
lecture_lines: Transformations allow us to manipulate signals.
Remove hiss or compress images easily.
Everything is just a sum of vibrations.
animations: Transform waveform into a frequency spectrum bar graph.
